name: Germany
filingNote: Calendar tax year. The return for 2026 is due on 31 July 2027 (29 February 2028 with an adviser), filed through ELSTER.
holdingRuleConditions: A swap or a purchase paid in crypto starts a new holding period for the coins received.
Gifts keep the giver's holding period.
lotRuleNote: Per wallet: the BMF accepts first in, first out or individual identification, elected per wallet and per crypto-asset and applied consistently; average cost is the fallback (medium-high confidence).

card.classification: A private sale (§ 23(1) sentence 1 no. 2 EStG) taxed at the personal progressive rate, not the flat Abgeltungsteuer; staking and lending rewards under § 22 no. 3 EStG. Basis: BMF-Schreiben of 6 March 2025; BFH IX R 3/22 of 14 February 2023.

taxableEvents.note: Taxable when one year or less lies between purchase and sale; tax-free after more than one year.
A disposal at market value and a new acquisition; a new holding period starts for the coin received.
The same as any swap: a disposal at market value and a new acquisition.
A disposal at the value of the goods or services.
Not a disposal; records are needed so the holding period can be traced from wallet to wallet.
No income tax; gift or inheritance tax may apply; the recipient steps into the acquisition date and cost of the giver (§ 23(1) sentence 3 EStG).
§ 22 no. 3 income at receipt (Freigrenze EUR 256); passive staking or lending does not extend the holding period to ten years (BMF 2022 and 2025).

rates.label: Personal income tax (§ 32a EStG)
rates.note: 0 % up to EUR 12,348; 14 % rising to 42 % at EUR 69,879; 45 % from EUR 277,826.

rates.label: Solidarity surcharge (§ 3 SolZG 1995)
rates.note: Only where the income tax exceeds EUR 20,350 (single) or EUR 40,700 (joint), with a sliding zone above.

allowances: Freigrenze of EUR 1,000 a year on all § 23 gains together (crypto and other private sales): at EUR 1,000 or more the whole amount is taxable, a cliff, not an allowance. Since assessment year 2024 (previously EUR 600).
Freigrenze of EUR 256 per year for § 22 no. 3 income (staking, lending).
The Sparer-Pauschbetrag does not apply to § 23 gains today.
card.holdingRuleText: Taxable only when “der Zeitraum zwischen Anschaffung und Veräußerung nicht mehr als ein Jahr beträgt” (§ 23(1) sentence 1 no. 2 EStG). The day of purchase is not counted and the year ends on the same calendar day a year later (§ 108 AO, §§ 187–188 BGB): bought on 15 March 2026, a sale on 15 March 2027 is still inside the year; from 16 March 2027 it is tax-free.
card.lotRuleText: First in, first out per wallet (“walletbezogene Betrachtung”); the BMF accepts FIFO or individual identification, elected per wallet and per crypto-asset; average cost is the fallback.
card.losses: Only against § 23 gains, not salary or capital income; carried back one year and forward without limit within § 23. Losses under § 22 no. 3 offset only § 22 no. 3 income.
reporting: The taxpayer bears the burden of proof; software tax reports are accepted if plausible and consistent (BMF-Schreiben of 6 March 2025).
caveats: The cut-off and grandfathering of the reform, a draft that may change.
card.summary60: Germany: crypto sold more than one year after purchase is tax-free. Sold within a year, the gain is taxed at your personal income-tax rate, and swaps and purchases with crypto count as sales. All such gains under EUR 1,000 per year are tax-free. First-in, first-out per wallet. A draft law would end the one-year rule for coins bought from 2027.

pendingChanges.title: Referentenentwurf of 30 September 2026: Gesetz zur Reform der Besteuerung bestimmter Kryptowerte im Privatvermögen
pendingChanges.summary: Tauschkryptowerte such as BTC and ETH acquired after 31 December 2026 would become capital income at 25 % plus solidarity surcharge, whatever the holding period, withheld by domestic providers from 1 January 2028; earlier purchases keep the one-year rule. E-money tokens, NFTs, security and RWA tokens are excluded. The cabinet slot of 14 October 2026 passed without a decision.
